name: Dublin Ohio Summer AM 2024
information:
This competition is organized by the Columbus Cubing Club - check out the [website](https://columbuscubingclub.weebly.com/) for information on meetings and future competitions!

This competition is a series competition with [Dublin Ohio Summer PM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DublinOhioSummerPM2024).

Extra rounds of certain listed events may be added if we run ahead of schedule.
